concepts.statement_en: RA 11223, the Universal Health Care Act of 2019, was enacted in February 2019 to ensure every Filipino has access to affordable, quality health service whenever they need it, without being pushed into hardship by the cost.
concepts.source: deck slide 17; facilitator-guide PDF 21; reference-manual PDF 13

concepts.statement_en: Under UHC, every Filipino is automatically covered by PhilHealth.
PhilHealth now also covers outpatient consultations, not only hospital confinement.
Every Filipino is to register with a primary care provider of their choice under UHC.
UHC organizes a clearer, better referral system between primary care and higher levels of care.
UHC reorganizes the DOH's previously separate, siloed health programs into one integrated system.
UHC designates the provincial or city health board as a partner in organizing and managing the province's or city's health system.
UHC directs an increase in the skill level expected of BHWs.
UHC intensifies health promotion within communities.
Under UHC, BHWs are designated barangay-level Health Education and Promotion Officers (HEPOs).
concepts.redundant_with: Taught in full in Module 1 (the HEPO umbrella and its three RA 7883 roles) — Module 2 only names that the designation comes from this law, without re-teaching the three roles.

concepts.statement_en: Module 2 maps to the TESDA BHS NC II competency 'Contribute to workplace innovation', whose outcomes are: identify opportunities to do things better, discuss and develop ideas with others, and integrate ideas for change in the workplace.
